name: Potential SMB Relay Attack Tool Execution
description: Detects different hacktools used for relay attacks on Windows for privilege escalation
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate files with these rare hacktool names
query: ((process.executable:(*PetitPotam* OR *RottenPotato* OR *HotPotato* OR *JuicyPotato* OR *\\just_dce_* OR *Juicy\ Potato* OR *\\temp\\rot.exe* OR *\\Potato.exe* OR *\\SpoolSample.exe* OR *\\Responder.exe* OR *\\smbrelayx* OR *\\ntlmrelayx* OR *\\LocalPotato*)) OR (process.command_line:(*Invoke\-Tater* OR *\ smbrelay* OR *\ ntlmrelay* OR *cme\ smb\ * OR *\ \/ntlm\:NTLMhash\ * OR *Invoke\-PetitPotam* OR *.exe\ \-t\ *\ \-p\ *)) OR (process.command_line:*.exe\ \-c\ \"\{* AND process.command_line:*\}\"\ \-z)) AND (NOT (process.executable:(*HotPotatoes6* OR *HotPotatoes7* OR *HotPotatoes\ *)))
